_meta.purpose: Balanced MCP tool descriptions — usable by Claude, IP-protected
_meta.principle: Tell Claude WHAT the tool does and WHEN to use it. Never reveal HOW (formulas, thresholds, internal names).

get_platform_instructions.description: Load platform context and usage guidelines. Call once at the start of each conversation.
get_platform_instructions.note: CRITICAL: This tool's response contains full architecture details. Sanitize the returned system prompt separately, or gate this tool behind auth.

get_kpi_catalog.description:
Get the metric catalog for a customer — metric names, weights, and categories. Auto-detects the customer's industry vertical and returns calibrated weights if available. Call this before referencing any metric names.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID (0 for platform defaults)

get_account_health.description:
Get health score and category breakdown for a specific account. Returns an overall score with per-category scores and trend direction.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to analyze

list_accounts.description:
List all accounts for a customer with health scores and revenue, sorted by health (worst first). Use for portfolio overview.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID

get_at_risk_accounts.description:
List accounts with health scores below a threshold. Returns accounts needing attention with revenue at risk and weakest category.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    threshold: Health score threshold (default 70)

get_health_score_history.description:
Get monthly health score history for an account or full portfolio. Returns trends, status transitions, turnaround stories, and deterioration alerts. Use for trajectory analysis.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: Specific account (0 = all accounts)
    months: Months of history (default 6, max 12)

get_revenue_at_risk.description:
Get authoritative revenue breakdown for an account: at-risk, protected, expansion, and lost. This is the ONLY source for revenue figures — never manually sum from other tools.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to analyze

calculate_power_of_1.description:
Calculate the revenue impact of improving a business metric by a given percentage. Supported metrics: NRR, GRR, product_adoption, expansion_rate, ticket_resolution_time, TTFV.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    metric_id: Metric to improve (e.g. 'NRR', 'GRR')
    improvement_pct: Percentage improvement (default 1.0)
    account_arr: Optional ARR override

get_nrr_forecast.description:
Get portfolio net revenue retention forecast with trajectory projections and renewal risk overlay. Shows current NRR, projected NRR with interventions, and per-account impact.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    months: Forecast horizon (default 3, max 12)

get_portfolio_roi_summary.description:
Get the complete ROI story for a portfolio — historical results, forward projections, and trajectory assessment across all accounts.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID

get_outcome_roi_story.description:
Generate a full ROI narrative for an account with proof points, projections, and evidence-based insights.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to analyze
    target_improvement_pct: Target improvement (default 10%)
    projection_months: Horizon in months (default 12)

get_playbook_economics.description:
Get cost and ROI estimates per intervention type — hours, automation savings, and projected impact tied to business metrics.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_arr: Optional ARR for scaling

get_csm_daily_actions.description:
Get top prioritized actions across all accounts. Each action includes the linked intervention, urgency, effort estimate, and projected dollar impact. Use for 'What should I do today?' questions.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID

get_playbook_recommendations.description:
Get recommended interventions for an account based on its health and signal patterns.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to get recommendations for

execute_playbook.description:
Start an intervention for an account. Records initial health and revenue for outcome tracking.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account
    playbook_id: Intervention ID (e.g. 'PB-01')
    triggered_by: Who triggered it (default 'csm_manual')

close_playbook.description:
Complete an intervention with outcome data. Computes ROI from health improvement and revenue impact.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    execution_id: The execution ID from execute_playbook
    outcome: Result — 'resolved', 'escalated', 'timeout', 'manual_close'
    outcome_notes: Free-text notes
    health_at_close: Health score at close
    revenue_protected: ARR protected (auto-computed if omitted)
    revenue_expanded: ARR from upsell/cross-sell
    csm_hours_actual: Actual hours spent

generate_playbook_from_description.description:
Generate a structured intervention plan from a natural-language description. Returns trigger conditions, actions, estimated hours, and owner roles. Does not save — returns for review.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    description: Natural language description

search_signals.description:
Search for events and signals in an account's evidence graph. Filter by event type and subtype.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to search
    node_type: Event type filter (default 'SIGNAL')
    node_subtype: Optional subtype filter
    limit: Max results (default 20)

submit_signal.description:
Submit a real-time signal for an account (email, Slack, transcript, or CSM observation). Creates a signal record and queues it for async LLM enrichment. The background worker extracts sentiment, intent, urgency, and stakeholder roles, then creates an evidence graph node for high-risk signals.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account this signal relates to
    raw_text: The signal text (email body, Slack message, transcript excerpt, observation)
    source_type: Signal source — 'manual' (default), 'email', 'slack', or 'transcript'
    consent_verified: Required true for transcript source_type (participant consent)

get_causal_chain.description:
Trace the causal chain from an event — upstream (what caused this) or downstream (what this led to).

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    node_id: Starting event ID
    direction: 'upstream' or 'downstream' (default 'upstream')

get_account_journey_timeline.description:
Get a chronological timeline of all events for an account with a pre-computed revenue summary. Preferred over multiple search_signals calls.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to analyze
    limit: Max events (default 50, max 200)

get_graph_summary.description:
Get event graph statistics and revenue breakdown for an account.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to analyze

get_context_graph_mermaid.description:
Generate a visual diagram of the evidence graph for an account. Returns a renderable Mermaid flowchart with color-coded events.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to visualize
    max_nodes: Maximum nodes (default 30, max 60)

get_stakeholder_map.description:
Get the stakeholder network for an account — contacts, roles, engagement details, and their influence on decisions and outcomes.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account to analyze

get_crm_account_data.description:
Pull CRM data for an account — contract details, renewal opportunity, champion contacts, usage metrics.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account

get_support_tickets.description:
Pull support ticket summary — open tickets, SLA compliance, escalations, risk indicators.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account

get_customer_feedback.description:
Pull customer feedback — NPS trend, satisfaction indicators, voice-of-customer summaries.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    account_id: The account

list_portfolio_customers.description:
List all companies in a portfolio with health and revenue summary.

Args:
    portfolio_id: The portfolio (PE fund / holding company) ID

get_portfolio_cross_customer_comparison.description:
Compare all companies in a portfolio side-by-side: health, revenue, risk, expansion. CEO-level view.

Args:
    portfolio_id: The portfolio ID

partner_portal.description:
Partner-scoped portal for channel health operations. All responses are scoped to partner metrics only — no revenue or other data exposed. Actions: scorecard, submit_data, actions, benchmarks, impact.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer (tenant) ID
    partner_id: The partner ID
    action: One of: scorecard, submit_data, actions, benchmarks, impact
    data_type: For submit_data only
    csv_content: For submit_data only
    metric_id: For impact only

create_customer.description:
Create a new customer with admin user and API key. First step in onboarding.

Args:
    name: Company name
    domain: Email domain
    vertical: Industry vertical slug
    admin_email: Admin user email
    admin_name: Admin display name
    tier: Optional configuration tier

clone_customer.description:
Deep-copy an existing customer with all data into a new customer for instant demo setup.

Args:
    source_customer_id: Customer to clone from
    new_name: Name for the new customer
    new_domain: Domain for the new customer

upload_csv.description:
Upload CSV data for a customer. Use dry_run=True to validate before persisting.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID
    file_type: CSV type (e.g. 'accounts.csv', 'kpi_measurements.csv')
    csv_content: Raw CSV content
    dry_run: If True, validate only

process_data.description:
Run the full data processing pipeline: data loading, health scoring, analytics, and signal analysis.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID
    mode: 'auto' (default) or 'full_recalc'

complete_onboarding.description:
Finalize onboarding or check status. When check_only=True, returns a checklist of what's done and what's missing.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID
    check_only: If True, return status without finalizing

configure_customer_kpis.description:
Configure which metrics are active and their weights for a customer. Supports category selection, metric selection, weight adjustment, and tier upgrades.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID
    enabled_pillars: Optional list of category codes
    enabled_kpis: Optional list of metric codes
    pillar_weights: Optional category weight overrides
    kpi_weights: Optional per-metric weight overrides
    lifecycle_stage_weights: Optional lifecycle stage definitions
    upgrade_tier: Optional tier name to upgrade to

enable_features.description:
Enable or disable feature flags for a customer. Returns current state if no features specified.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID
    features: List of feature names to enable

trigger_wizard.description:
Run an analytics engine for a customer: journey classification, pattern analysis, or weight calibration.

Args:
    customer_id: The customer ID
    wizard: Which engine — 'a' (journeys), 'b' (patterns), or 'c' (calibration)

list_verticals.description: List available industry verticals with metric counts and configuration templates.

list_customers.description: List recent customers grouped by vertical. Use to find the correct customer_id.

get_csv_templates.description:
Get CSV column schemas for data uploads — required and optional columns per file type.

Args:
    vertical: The industry vertical
    file_type: Optional specific file type

download_customer_csv.description:
Export customer data as CSV content.

Args:
    customer_id: Customer to export
    file_type: Which CSV ('all', 'accounts', 'kpi_measurements', etc.)
